title: CareFirst and Under Armour Partner to Advance Youth Health and Well-Being Across Baltimore and Washington, DC
summary: — CareFirst BlueCross BlueShield (CareFirst), one of the region's largest not-for-profit healthcare organizations, announced earlier this week a new partnership with Under Armour through Project Rampart, a youth development initiative started by Under Armour dedicated to elevating the student-athlete experience and improving academic outcomes through sport, mentorship and academic support.
body_markdown:
[CareFirst BlueCross BlueShield (CareFirst)](https://individual.carefirst.com/individuals-families/home.page) , one of the region's largest not-for-profit healthcare organizations, announced earlier this week a new partnership with[Under Armour](https://about.underarmour.com/en) through[Project Rampart](https://about.underarmour.com/en/Purpose/impact/project-rampart.html) , a youth development initiative started by Under Armour dedicated to elevating the student-athlete experience and improving academic outcomes through sport, mentorship and academic support.


As two anchor institutions with deep roots in the region, CareFirst and Under Armour are coming together through a three-year grant to invest in the health and well-being of young people across Baltimore and Washington, D.C. The partnership will support six athletic and recreational space improvements over the life of the grant, helping expand access to safe, high-quality athletic and recreational spaces, youth programming and support systems that promote physical health, mental well-being, leadership development and academic success.
